# Test-only snapshot of the accepted Router response contract.
# Source: homelab/jarvis-router jarvis-router-api at bc2fe946f2da0d52839e158b3d9fa4636bf50f25.
# Only these pure definitions are executed by the offline contract test.
import re

class CoreProtocolError(Exception):
    """Core did not provide an unambiguous capability envelope."""

def label(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]{1,80}", value) is not None

def capability_response(value, request):
    """None is permission for semantic routing; all claimed results are terminal.

    Current Core omits claimed from JSON. Its dispatcher only serializes claimed
    results, so a named domain is the compatibility ownership signal.
    """
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or type(value.get("handled")) is not bool:
        raise CoreProtocolError()
    handled = value["handled"]
    domain = value.get("domain")
    if "claimed" in value and type(value["claimed"]) is not bool:
        raise CoreProtocolError()
    claimed = value.get("claimed", domain is not None)
    if not claimed:
        if (handled or "domain" not in value or domain is not None
                or value.get("path") != "semantic"
                or any(k in value for k in ("speech", "operation_status", "result"))
                or value.get("continue_conversation", False) is not False):
            raise CoreProtocolError()
        return None
    if not label(domain):
        raise CoreProtocolError()
    if "path" in value and not label(value["path"]):
        raise CoreProtocolError()
    if "continue_conversation" in value and type(value["continue_conversation"]) is not bool:
        raise CoreProtocolError()
    if "operation_status" in value and not label(value["operation_status"]):
        raise CoreProtocolError()
    calls = value.get("mcp_calls")
    if calls is not None and (type(calls) is not int or calls < 0):
        raise CoreProtocolError()
    speech = value.get("speech")
    if "speech" in value and (not isinstance(speech, str) or not speech.strip()):
        raise CoreProtocolError()

    # Preserve nutrition's existing status/continuation validation, including
    # write-reconciliation instructions, without using it to decide ownership.
    if domain == "nutrition":
        status = value.get("operation_status")
        if not speech or status not in {
            "read", "completed", "already_completed", "clarification_required",
            "confirmation_required", "cancelled", "unavailable", "reconciliation_required",
        }:
            status = "invalid_response"
            speech = "I could not verify the nutrition response. Please check SparkyFitness before retrying a write."
        return {"speech": speech, "operation_status": status,
                "conversation_id": request.get("conversation_id"), "request_id": request.get("request_id"),
                "domain": domain, "mcp_calls": calls,
                "continue_conversation": status in ("clarification_required", "confirmation_required")}

    # Old music/replay results lack speech. These renderers never dispatch work.
    # A top-level speech contract, when provided, always takes precedence.
    if speech is None and domain == "music":
        result = value.get("result") or {}
        if not isinstance(result, dict):
            raise CoreProtocolError()
        name, target = result.get("name"), result.get("target_name")
        if any(x is not None and (not isinstance(x, str) or not x.strip()) for x in (name, target)):
            raise CoreProtocolError()
        if not handled:
            speech = "I understood that as a music request, but I can't perform that music request yet."
        elif name and target:
            speech = f"Playing {name} in {target}."
        elif name:
            speech = f"Playing {name}."
        else:
            speech = "Done."
        return {"speech": speech}
    if speech is None and domain == "replay":
        result = value.get("result")
        if not isinstance(result, dict) or result.get("replayed") is not handled:
            raise CoreProtocolError()
        # Core already delivered the announcement; never repeat its message.
        return {"speech": "I repeated the last announcement." if handled else
                "I can't repeat the last announcement right now.",
                "domain": domain, "operation_status": "completed" if handled else "unavailable",
                "continue_conversation": False}
    if speech is None:
        raise CoreProtocolError()
    return {"speech": speech, "domain": domain, "handled": handled,
            "claimed": True, "operation_status": value.get("operation_status", "completed" if handled else "not_handled"),
            "conversation_id": request.get("conversation_id"), "request_id": request.get("request_id"),
            "continue_conversation": value.get("continue_conversation", False)}
